description: A feature folder with a public API: other code imports only its `index.js`; every other file is private.
The `index.js` that re-exports, by name, the components, hooks and functions a feature offers to the rest of the app.
An import that reaches past a module's index into its internals (`features/cart/model/CartContext`), coupling the consumer to the feature's file layout.
`export { Name } from './file'` lists every public name; `export *` leaks whatever the internal files happen to export.
Code needed by two features goes to a lower layer (`shared`, or an entity), never into one of the features for the other to import.
